#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Usage examples:
#   ./scripts/check-internal-web.sh                 # uses default IPs
#   ./scripts/check-internal-web.sh 10.0.0.1 10.0.0.2
#   IPS_FILE=./ips.txt ./scripts/check-internal-web.sh
#
# Notes:
# - Only checks HTTP on port 80.
# - Uses curl by default; falls back to wget if curl is unavailable.

DEFAULT_IPS=(
  "192.168.0.1"
  "192.168.0.10"
  "192.168.0.20"
)

PORT=80
CONNECT_TIMEOUT=2
MAX_TIME=4

read_ips_from_file() {
  local f="$1"
  # allow comments/blank lines
  grep -Ev '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$f" | tr -d '\r'
}

IPS=()
if [[ "${IPS_FILE:-}" != "" && -f "${IPS_FILE}" ]]; then
  while IFS= read -r ip; do IPS+=("$ip"); done < <(read_ips_from_file "$IPS_FILE")
elif (( $# > 0 )); then
  IPS=("$@");
else
  IPS=("${DEFAULT_IPS[@]}");
fi

has_curl=false
has_wget=false
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && has_curl=true
command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1 && has_wget=true

if [[ "$has_curl" != true && "$has_wget" != true ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: need curl or wget" >&2
  exit 127
fi

printf "%-15s  %-6s  %s\n" "IP" "STATUS" "DETAIL"
printf -- "%.0s-" {1..60}; echo

for ip in "${IPS[@]}"; do
  url="http://${ip}:${PORT}/"

  if [[ "$has_curl" == true ]]; then
    # -sS: silent but show errors; -o /dev/null: discard body
    # -w: print code; --connect-timeout/max-time bound time
    code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
      --connect-timeout "$CONNECT_TIMEOUT" \
      --max-time "$MAX_TIME" \
      "$url" 2>/dev/null || true)

    if [[ "$code" =~ ^[0-9]{3}$ && "$code" != "000" ]]; then
      printf "%-15s  %-6s  %s\n" "$ip" "$code" "OK"
    else
      printf "%-15s  %-6s  %s\n" "$ip" "FAIL" "no response / connect timeout"
    fi
  else
    # wget fallback: use --spider to avoid downloading; parse status line.
    out=$(wget -q --server-response --spider -T "$CONNECT_TIMEOUT" -t 1 "$url" 2>&1 || true)
    code=$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | awk '/^  HTTP\//{print $2; exit}')
    if [[ "$code" =~ ^[0-9]{3}$ ]]; then
      printf "%-15s  %-6s  %s\n" "$ip" "$code" "OK"
    else
      printf "%-15s  %-6s  %s\n" "$ip" "FAIL" "no response / connect timeout"
    fi
  fi

done
